mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits catecholamine metabolism, potentially causing hypertensive crisis when combined with beta-blockers that may mask sympathomimetic symptoms; additive CNS depression risk also present.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, and consider alternative antidepressant; allow 14 days washout after phenelzine discontinuation before starting metoprolol.
